solution:

• In this arrangement, the **sentence begins by introducing the subject** "sloths" in Part S.
 
• It then explains how sloths' slow movement leads to the growth of algae on their fur** (Part P)**, which gives them a green color** (Part R) **that aids in their camouflage and helps them hide in the forest** (Part Q). **

• **R. **this can give sloths a green color that helps them hide in
